Duke & Duke club canapés.d: Prunes stuffed with a whole almond, wrapped in bacon and baked until crisp.
Duke & Duke club canapés.note: Passed hot on trays from three.

Frozen orange juice shots.d: Vodka and orange juice whirled in the blender with crushed ice, in small glasses.

Billy Ray's club dinner.d: Standing rib, salted a day ahead, roasted slow and carved to order. Natural juices, horseradish cream, browned potatoes.
Billy Ray's club dinner.note: Carved by the Heritage Club man.

Orange cake.d: Grated rind and juice in the batter, brushed warm with a thick citrus syrup.

Mimosa.d: Fresh-squeezed orange juice and chilled champagne, half and half, in a tall flute.
Mimosa.note: Friday at the bar, three until six.
